intro: Filipino culture mixes Malay, Spanish, American and Chinese influences, with a big love of music, food and celebrations.

chapters.title: Music and karaoke
text: Karaoke, or videoke, is a national pastime, and Filipino singers are famous across Asia. The Christmas season starts in September and lasts until January.

chapters.title: Fiestas
text: Every town has a fiesta for its patron saint. Sinulog in Cebu and Ati-Atihan in Aklan feature drums and street dancing. Jeepneys, brightly painted public buses based on old US army jeeps, are a symbol of the country.

chapters.title: Food
text: Adobo, sinigang (sour soup), lechon (roast pig) and halo-halo (shaved ice with many toppings) are favourites. Rice is eaten at almost every meal.
